query_text: Longitudinal studies that used latent growth mixture modelling (LGMM) or a related clustering method (latent class growth analysis, hierarchical cluster analysis) to identify latent trajectories of posttraumatic stress symptoms (PTSD) after a traumatic event: which trajectories are reported, in what proportions, and with which growth parameters, so that the findings can inform the priors of a Bayesian latent growth mixture model of PTSD trajectories? Longitudinal study with at least three measurement waves measuring PTSD. PTSD was measured on a continuous scale via an interview or questionnaire. The study used a clustering method (latent growth mixture modelling, latent class growth analysis, hierarchical cluster analysis) to identify trajectories or classes. Traumatic stress symptoms follow events that appear to fulfill DSM-IV criterion A1 for PTSD or acute stress disorder. At title/abstract stage the screening was over-inclusive: any paper that appears to apply one of the cluster techniques within the context of trauma is kept, and if there is any doubt the study is included for full-text reading.
